prompt:
Internal audit draft, public-distributable input only.

The relay seats are now callable without an explicit-request gate: a dispatch that does not mention relay is recorded as relay_dispatch.deviation instead of being refused. Write a short plain-text note (max 220 words) describing exactly what such an audit record must contain so a reviewer can later judge whether a relay dispatch was justified: the seats used, whether the original request mentioned relay, the deviation flag, the native seats that were available, and what evidence would be needed to show a native seat could not do the work. Also state plainly what this audit does NOT prove.

Do not invent run ids, commits, balances or provider metadata. No JSON envelope, no tools, no external action.
